references.citation: Upreti, K., Subbarayan, G. "Signed algebraic level sets on NURBS surfaces and implicit Boolean compositions for isogeometric CAD-CAE integration." Computer-Aided Design 82:112-126, 2017. Online 2016.
references.why: Signed algebraic level sets for NURBS B-reps: each Bezier patch implicitized by the Dixon resultant (degree 18 for bicubic), normalized by its gradient, trimmed to its control hull and composed with R-functions; sign outside the hulls by ray casting. Read through its restatement in the Liao 2022 thesis (entry 80): it does not give a usable global leaf for a B-spline face (self-intersections of the implicit inside the hull flip the sign, knot insertion cannot fix it, false zero sets along trim curves, no certified bound).
